mechanism_of_action: Improves insulin sensitivity and promotes weight loss; increased hepatic de novo lipogenesis and unchanged fatty acid oxidation partly explain the lack of improvement in intrahepatic triglyceride content.
primary_endpoint: Change in intrahepatic triglyceride content after 12 weeks of metformin treatment.
efficacy_outcome: After 12 weeks, intrahepatic triglyceride content and fatty acid oxidation remained unchanged; body weight decreased and insulin sensitivity improved. VLDL-triglyceride concentrations decreased, while the relative contribution of de novo lipogenesis-derived fatty acids to VLDL-triglyceride increased.
